shortDescription: Rising crude oil prices and a sharp jump in US bond yields are clouding India's market outlook, says Nitin Bhasin of Ambit Institutional Equities. He recommends staying invested in companies with strong earnings and favours large-cap banks, NBFCs and telecom stocks.

title: Crude and rising US yields weigh on India: Ambit's Nitin Bhasin on where to invest now
